verdict.rationale: Bolna documents Workflows: multi-step outreach sequences combining voice calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven through the API. It also documents batches and automatic post-call pushes of data to a CRM. Together these show unattended automations, but the evidence never describes how they are triggered, scheduled or monitored while running in the background, and the workflow evidence is a single summary line. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules or event triggers, detail on background execution and monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Build multi-step outreach sequences that combine voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven entirely through the Bolna API.
Push data to your CRM from every call.
lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal
